subject: Host your next gathering above the Badlands
preheader: Weddings, retreats, private dinners and reunions at the Library.

props.text: Host Your Event at the Library

props.html:
Hello [[FIRSTNAME OR "Friend"]],

You have seen the galleries by day. After hours, the Library hosts weddings, leadership retreats, private dinners and family reunions, with sunset over the Badlands as the backdrop.

props.alt: Two people on the Library boardwalk looking out over the Badlands

rows: Indoor and outdoor ceremonies, terraces above the Little Missouri, and receptions in spaces most guests see only once.
Board retreats, offsites, client trips and launches, with private conference space.
Seated dinners for 12 to 60, or cocktails on a terrace as the light drops.
Conferences, galas and convenings in a nonpartisan setting.

props.html: Every event includes the Library's events team and its list of regional caterers and partners. Add curator-led tours or after-hours access to the galleries.
